To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the first structure of a MnLOX is presented, and that the structure of the MnLOX of Magnaporthe orzyae (Mo-MnLOX) reveals a unique variation of the LOX fold.

(i) we have solved the structure of a manganese lipoxygenase from the rice blast fungus, Magnaporthe orzya (ii) we show that the metal coordinating sphere of this enzyme is similar to iron lipoxygenases, (iii) we show that a short loop is positioned instead of an α helix, which is a unique feature, and (iv) the structure provides a basis to understand the unique supraficial mechanism of the enzyme.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the structural basis for the catalytic mechanism of lipoxygenase, a non-heme iron protein.
the elucidation of the molecular basis of the catalytic function of MnLOX of rice blast fungus.
the structure, the catalytic mechanism, and the metal specificity of lipoxygenase, a non-heme metalloenzyme.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MnLOX is a unique variation on the theme of LOX, and that the Mn ion is a unique metal for the catalytic center of LOX.
the structural basis for the metal specificity of LOX is not yet understood.
Mo-Mn-LOX is an enzyme of the lipoxygenase family, which is structurally related to the FeLOX of animals, fungi, and plants.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MnLOX of fungi and prokaryota have a similar structural basis but different substrate access and oxygenation mechanism compared to animal, plant, or bacterial FeLOX.
we solved the first three-dimensional structure of MnLOX and that we identified a unique structural element that may contribute to the suprafacial hydrogen atom abstraction and oxygenation by MnLOX.
MnLOX of M. oryzae was expressed and crystallized, the first structure of a MnLOX has been solved, and the structure of Mo-Mn-LOX was determined.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the structure of Mo-Mn-LOX provides a basis for the rationalization of the unique properties of this enzyme.
the structure of Mo-Mn-LOX is similar to the structure of FeLOX, but there are some differences that are unique to MnLOX.
we have solved the first crystal structure of a Mn-LOX, which provides a unique opportunity to compare the structures of MnLOX and FeLOX.
